events.title: Grounded spec built
events.reasoning: The code, config map, endpoint list and PRD all confirm that Procol can create multi‑stage sourcing events (RFP, RFQ, auction), invite vendors, award contracts, and manage users by team. In the PRD the phone field is defined to accept any 10‑digit number, but the backend implementation only checks length, not that the characters are digits. This mismatch creates a spec‑vs‑product gap that could allow invalid phone entries, so it should be added to the test suite.

deltas.prdSays: Accept any 10-digit number; reject malformed input politely (PRD §4.3, §5).
deltas.productDoes: The API checks phone LENGTH (rejects 9 or 11 digits) but NOT that characters are digits — it accepts a 10-char value containing letters. The frontend enforces digits-only, so the API is more lenient than the UI.
